## Claims

<a id="pnt_equivalent"></a>
### `pnt_equivalent`

The number of primes up to x is asymptotically equivalent to x over log x (outside source; word for word PNT+ pi_alt').

```lean
/-- **The prime number theorem** (outside source; word for word the statement
of PNT+ `pi_alt'`). -/
def pnt_equivalent : Prop :=
  Asymptotics.IsEquivalent atTop (fun (x : ℝ) ↦ (Nat.primeCounting ⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ))
    (fun x ↦ x / Real.log x)
```

**Rests on:** no other node (Mathlib and the Vocabulary only)

**Proof:** `None` in [`None`](../../None)

<a id="prime_number_theorem"></a>
### `prime_number_theorem`

The number of primes up to x times log x over x tends to 1.

```lean
/-- **The prime number theorem, limit form.** The number of primes up to `x`,
times the logarithm of `x`, divided by `x`, tends to 1. -/
def prime_number_theorem : Prop :=
  Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => (Nat.primeCounting ⌊x⌋₊ : ℝ) * Real.log x / x) atTop (𝓝 1)
```

**Rests on:** [`PrimeNumberTheorem.pnt_equivalent`](PrimeNumberTheorem.md#pnt_equivalent)

**Proof:** `RNS.PrimeNumberTheorem.prime_number_theorem_step` in [`RNSSolutions/PrimeNumberTheorem.lean`](../../RNSSolutions/PrimeNumberTheorem.lean)
